newsitem.title: USA: IPL Systems names post-merger executives.
newsitem.headline: IPL Systems names post-merger executives.

text.p: IPL Systems Inc said its has completed its merger with privately held ANDATACO, and has named a new chairman, chief executive and president.
The combined computer storage company named Harris Ravine chairman and chief executive. David Sykes, the controlling shareholder of the combined company, was named president.

Under the merger, ANDATACO shareholders were issued a total of 18,078,381 shares of IPL Class A Common Stock, of which 10 percent are to be held in escrow for one year. An additional 272,982 shares were reserved for issuance upon exercise of certain outstanding warrants and options of ANDATACO.
IPL now has a total of 23,712,200 shares issued and outstanding.
Shares are to be traded on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market under the symbol "IPLS."
